literal: For the aged and infirm, increase salary so they may retire at home.
idiomatic: Those who were old and enfeebled were granted higher stipends so they could withdraw and live at home.

literal: In the fifth month, on dinghai day, the Double Fifth festival — being drunk, he did not accept congratulations.
idiomatic: On dinghai day in the fifth month, the Double Fifth festival, he was already drunk and refused the customary congratulations.

literal: On renchen day he caught geese at the Shugu River and drank in the wild through the night.
idiomatic: On renchen day he took geese at the Shugu River and caroused in the open country all night long.

literal: On dingyou day he drank heavily with Affairs commissioner Xiao Paiya, Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun, Grand Preceptor Zhaogu, Liu Chengxun, and others, day and night without pause.
idiomatic: On dingyou day he went on a binge with Affairs commissioner Xiao Paiya, Nanjing garrison commander Gao Xun, Grand Preceptor Zhaogu, Liu Chengxun, and others, drinking day and night without letup.

literal: On yihai day he killed the deer keepers Pode, Lage, Taogui, Zhabuge, Sugunie, Chubao, Migute, Dida, and others.
idiomatic: On yihai day he put to death the deer keepers Pode, Lage, Taogui, Zhabuge, Sugunie, Chubao, Migute, Dida, and others.

literal: In the sixth month, on bingchen day, he killed pig keeper Tunnu.
idiomatic: On bingchen day in the sixth month he killed pig keeper Tunnu.

literal: On jiwei day he set up a divine tent for Palace Front inspector Yilige and proclaimed a partial amnesty for prisoners in the capital region.
idiomatic: On jiwei day he erected a divine tent for Palace Front inspector Yilige and granted a limited amnesty to prisoners in the capital region.

literal: On jiaxu day Tielie obtained a bitch from an eagle nest and presented her.
idiomatic: On jiaxu day Tielie found a female dog in an eagle nest and brought her as tribute.

literal: That summer he sought cool at Cangtan.
idiomatic: That summer he took his summer quarters at Cangtan.

literal: In the seventh month of autumn, on xinchou day, Han's ruler Chengjun died and his son Jiyuan succeeded; Han sent word, and envoys were dispatched to mourn and sacrifice.
idiomatic: On xinchou day in the seventh autumn month Han's ruler Liu Chengjun died and his son Liu Jiyuan succeeded; when Han reported the death, the court sent envoys to offer condolences and perform the mourning rites.

literal: In the ninth month, on wuzi day, he killed the four men xiangwen Balu, Zhuahen Du, and others.
idiomatic: On wuzi day in the ninth month he executed xiangwen Balu, Zhuahen Du, and two others.

literal: On jichou day he climbed a small hill and sacrificed to Heaven and Earth.
idiomatic: On jichou day he ascended a small hill and offered sacrifice to Heaven and Earth.

literal: On wuxu day, learning that Song intended to strike Hedong, he instructed Southwest military governor and Southern Court Great King Tielie to prepare in advance.
idiomatic: On wuxu day, when he learned that Song planned to attack Hedong, he ordered Southwest military governor and Southern Court Great King Tielie to ready defenses in advance.

literal: On yihai day he hunted bear and granted deer-caller Pugu together with palace household servants to Yilige.
idiomatic: On yihai day he hunted bear and gave deer-caller Pugu, together with palace household staff, to Yilige.

literal: On jiachen day Yilige was additionally made Affairs commissioner; several tens of li of land at Mozhen east of Black Mountain were granted him; Nu Gui was made a personal attendant, and Jurchen xiangwen Gamo was made yilijin of his department.
idiomatic: On jiachen day Yilige was also appointed Affairs commissioner and granted several tens of li of land at Mozhen east of Black Mountain; Nu Gui became his personal attendant, and Jurchen xiangwen Gamo was made yilijin of his household.

literal: That autumn he hunted on the mountains around the Western Capital.
idiomatic: That autumn he hunted in the hills around the Western Capital.

literal: In the tenth month of winter, on the xinhai new moon, Song besieged Taiyuan; an edict made Tielie grand commander of army and horse and ordered troops from every circuit to the rescue.
idiomatic: That winter, on the xinhai new moon of the tenth month, Song besieged Taiyuan; Tielie was made grand commander of army and horse and troops from every circuit were mobilized to relieve the city.

literal: In the eleventh month, on guimao day, the winter solstice — being drunk, he did not accept congratulations.
idiomatic: On guimao day in the eleventh month, the winter solstice, he was drunk and again refused congratulations.

literal: In the twelfth month, on dingchou day, he killed wine steward Dalage.
idiomatic: On dingchou day in the twelfth month he killed wine steward Dalage.

literal: That winter the court encamped at Black Mountain East Stream.
idiomatic: That winter the court made its winter quarters at Black Mountain East Stream.

literal: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first month of spring, he held a banquet in the palace and did not accept congratulations.
idiomatic: In the nineteenth year, on the yimao new moon of the first spring month, he feasted in the palace and refused the customary congratulations.

literal: On jichou day, at the Start of Spring, being drunk, he ordered Palace Front inspector Yilige to perform the striking-the-earth-ox ritual in his stead.
idiomatic: On jichou day, the Start of Spring, too drunk to attend himself, he had Palace Front inspector Yilige perform the earth-ox ceremony in his place.

literal: On jiawu day he played the yage game with the ministers.
idiomatic: On jiawu day he joined the ministers in the yage board game.

literal: On wuxu day, while drunk, he suddenly promoted attendants on the left and right.
idiomatic: On wuxu day, in his cups, he abruptly raised the ranks of attendants on either side.

literal: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage, saying, "When I handle affairs while drunk and go astray, you must not simply comply.
idiomatic: On yisi day he issued an edict to Grand Preceptor Huage: "When I decide matters in drunkenness and go wrong, you must not simply defer to me.

literal: When the wine has cleared, you may resubmit your memorial.
idiomatic: Once I am sober, you may submit the matter again.

literal: " From the Start of Spring he drank until the month ended and did not attend to government.
idiomatic: " From the Start of Spring he kept drinking until the month was out and did not govern.

literal: In the second month, on jiayin day, Liu Jiyuan of Han succeeded to the throne and sent envoys requesting investiture.
idiomatic: On jiayin day in the second month Liu Jiyuan succeeded in Han and sent envoys begging investiture and a patent of enfeoffment.

literal: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was dispatched to invest him as emperor.
idiomatic: On xinyou day Han Zhifan was sent to invest him as emperor.

literal: On guihai day he killed the forward guides Mo and Yila, dismembered their corpses, and cast them away.
idiomatic: On guihai day he killed the forward guides Mo and Yila, hacked apart their bodies, and abandoned them.

literal: On jiazi day Han sent envoys presenting white sable.
idiomatic: On jiazi day Han sent envoys with tribute of white sable.

literal: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted and captured a bear, drank joyfully until drunk, and galloped back to the mobile palace.
idiomatic: On jisi day he went to Huai Prefecture, hunted down a bear, drank himself merry until he was drunk, then galloped back to the traveling palace.

literal: That night attendants Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and six others in all rebelled; the Emperor met assassination at age thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.
idiomatic: That night personal attendant Xiaoge, washer Huage, cook Xingu, and three others — six men in all — rose in revolt; the Emperor was assassinated at thirty-nine; his temple name was Muzong.

literal: Later he was attached in burial at Huai Mausoleum.
idiomatic: He was later buried by attachment at Huai Mausoleum.

literal: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi his posthumous title was Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.
idiomatic: In the twenty-first year of Chongxi he was posthumously titled Emperor Xia'an Jingzheng.

literal: The eulogy says: Muzong reigned eighteen years; he knew the witch's sorcery was false and had her executed, and he admonished his ministers against excessive punishment — he was not unintelligent.
idiomatic: The eulogy says: Muzong held the throne for eighteen years; he saw through the witch's fraud and had her killed, and he urgently warned his ministers against arbitrary punishments — he was not without understanding.

literal: Yet he abandoned himself to wine and hunted without satiety.
idiomatic: Yet he gave himself over to drink and hunted without end.

literal: When goose scouts missed their deadline he imposed branding-iron and iron-comb torture;
idiomatic: If goose scouts failed to return on time he applied branding irons and iron combs;

literal: when he caught ducks he was greatly pleased and abolished the hawk-ward decree on facial tattooing.
idiomatic: when he took ducks he was so delighted that he lifted the hawk-ward order for facial tattooing.

literal: Rewards and punishments had no fixed rule; he would not look to court affairs, yet he never ceased killing.
idiomatic: Reward and punishment followed no consistent rule; he ignored the business of government, yet his appetite for bloodshed never slackened.

literal: That rebellion arose from those at his elbow — as it should!
idiomatic: That the revolt sprang from men at his very side was only to be expected!
